create.name: Samadhi Yoga Ashram
create.bio:
Samadhi Yoga Ashram is a residential yoga school beside the Ganga at Laxman Jhula in Rishikesh. Yogi Vishnu Panigrahi, who grew up in western Odisha, started it in 2011 and still guides it as spiritual director, with Maa Haripriya as co-founder and Kundalini teacher. The ashram places itself in the Himalayan tradition of Swami Rama, through Yogi Vishnu's own training with Swami Veda Bharati, and treats asana as one strand among pranayama, meditation, mantra, kriya, philosophy and karma yoga. A second campus runs in Ubud, Bali.

Its main work is Yoga Alliance-registered teacher training: multi-style courses at 100, 200, 300 and 500 hours drawing on Hatha, Ashtanga and Vinyasa, and a parallel Kundalini and Tantra track, with new groups starting at the beginning of each month and students living on site with vegetarian meals. A faculty of Rishikesh-trained teachers covers asana, pranayama, the Yoga Sutras, Vedanta and meditation. The ashram also hosts short yoga and meditation retreats on rolling dates, drop-in classes for visitors seven days a week, and some online trainings, and it keeps a free library of classic texts for download.

courses.title: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh
courses.description: A 25-day residential foundation course mixing Hatha, Ashtanga and Vinyasa, with daily pranayama and meditation and classes in anatomy, the Yoga Sutras and teaching method. Groups begin on the first of each month, and the fee covers room and meals.

courses.title: 300 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh
courses.description: The advanced 29-day residential course for teachers who already hold a 200-hour qualification, deepening asana, pranayama, philosophy and teaching skills. Taken after the 200-hour course it completes the 500-hour level.

courses.title: 200 Hour Kundalini Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh
courses.description: A 25-day residential training in Kundalini and Tantra practice rooted in the Himalayan tradition: kriyas, pranayama, bandhas, mudras, mantra and chakra meditation, with classical Hatha asana as support and readings from the Hatha Yoga Pradipika. Shorter and longer tracks are also offered.

courses.title: Yoga and Meditation Retreat in Rishikesh
courses.description: Stays of 5, 7, 14 or 21 days at the ashram with daily yoga, pranayama, meditation and philosophy, vegetarian meals and visits to the evening Ganga Aarti and Kunjapuri temple. Start dates are open all year; the five-day price is for a shared room, and longer stays are quoted on request.

courses.title: Daily drop-in yoga classes in Rishikesh
courses.description: Hour-long Hatha and Ashtanga classes open to visitors at every level, held mornings and evenings seven days a week at the Laxman Jhula ashram. Single classes or multi-class cards are available.

free_resources.title: Free Yoga Library
free_resources.description: A set of classic texts the ashram uses in its trainings, free to read or download without giving an email: Vivekananda on the Yoga Sutras and on meditation, Satyananda on Yoga Nidra, an anatomy reference and a mantra book compiled by Yogi Vishnu.
